column3: “All still my breath” is rendered “as long as life is in me.”
The oath form “if they will speak” is rendered “certainly will not speak.”
“One who raises himself against me” is rendered “my opponent.”
“In the hand of God” is rendered “in the power of God.”
“By the death” is rendered “because of the plague.” “His widows” is rendered “their widows,” and NASB supplies “be able to.”
“Like the moth” is rendered “like the spider's web.”
The Hebrew reads “not he will be removed”; NASB follows another reading, “but never again.”
“He will throw” is rendered “it will hurl”; the subject is uncertain.
